title: Simply Good Foods Co 8-K Filing — 2026-04-21
summary: Simply Good Foods Co filed an 8-K announcing the departure of Ms. Amy Held, Senior Vice President and Chief Human Resources Officer, by June 1, 2026. The Compensation Committee accelerated vesting of 6,881 time-based RSUs to June 1, 2026, and she will receive benefits under the company's Executive Severance Plan.
key_points: Ms. Amy Held, Senior VP and Chief Human Resources Officer (named executive officer), departing by June 1, 2026
Compensation Committee accelerated vesting of 6,881 time-based Restricted Stock Units to June 1, 2026
Ms. Held entitled to benefits under Third Amended and Restated Executive Severance Plan
Filing signed by CFO Christopher J. Bealer on April 21, 2026
Company is Simply Good Foods Co (ticker: SMPL), listed on Nasdaq
